actor_awards.notes: Known for his dapper style and a trademark waxed mustache, he was a major star of both the silent and sound eras. He received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor for his role as Walter Burns in 'The Front Page' (1931). He was a highly visible and controversial figure during the McCarthy era due to his strong anti-communist stance.

filmography.title: Paths of Glory
filmography.role_description: The cynical and manipulative corps commander who goads a subordinate general into ordering a suicidal attack, and later convenes a court-martial to execute soldiers for cowardice.
filmography.plot: After a failed attack on a German position during World War I, a French general orders three soldiers to be tried for cowardice to cover up his own military blunder.

filmography.title: A Star Is Born
filmography.role_description: A powerful Hollywood studio executive who mentors the rising star Vicki Lester while dealing with her husband's decline.
filmography.plot: A young actress arrives in Hollywood with hopes of stardom, finding success and romance with a fading matinee idol whose career is on a downward spiral.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Writing, Original Story

filmography.title: The Front Page
filmography.role_description: The ruthless and manipulative newspaper editor who will do anything to keep his star reporter from quitting to get married.
filmography.plot: A star reporter tries to quit his job to marry, but his manipulative editor tricks him into covering one last big story about an escaped convict.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Actor (Menjou), Best Picture, Best Director

filmography.title: A Farewell to Arms
filmography.role_description: An Italian army doctor and close friend to the protagonist, whose attempts to protect his friend inadvertently lead to tragedy.
filmography.plot: An American ambulance driver and an English nurse fall in love in Italy during World War I, but face the grim realities of war and separation.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Cinematography, Best Sound Recording

filmography.title: Morocco
filmography.role_description: A wealthy and sophisticated gentleman in Morocco who falls in love with a cabaret singer and offers her a life of luxury.
filmography.plot: A cabaret singer arrives in Morocco and becomes the object of affection for both a wealthy older man and a handsome, reckless Foreign Legionnaire.

filmography.title: State of the Union
filmography.role_description: A cynical political strategist hired to manage the presidential campaign of a successful industrialist.
filmography.plot: An industrialist is urged to run for President, but requires the support of his estranged wife to appear as a happy family man to the public.

filmography.title: Pollyanna
filmography.role_description: A wealthy, reclusive, and cantankerous man whose heart is softened by the optimistic young Pollyanna. Menjou's final film role.
filmography.plot: A cheerful young orphan moves in with her wealthy but stern aunt and brings a little sunshine into the lives of the embittered townspeople.

filmography.title: The Sheik
filmography.role_description: A French doctor and friend to the Sheik, who serves as a moral compass and attempts to moderate the Sheik's actions.
filmography.plot: A charming Arabian sheik becomes infatuated with an adventurous, modern-thinking Englishwoman and abducts her to his home in the desert.

filmography.title: Stage Door
filmography.role_description: A powerful and predatory theatrical producer who preys on the aspiring actresses living in a boarding house.
filmography.plot: A boardinghouse for aspiring actresses houses a mix of personalities, all hoping for their big break on Broadway, while dealing with a manipulative producer.

filmography.title: A Woman of Paris
filmography.role_description: A wealthy, sophisticated, and cynical Parisian playboy who takes a young woman from the country as his mistress.
filmography.plot: A woman from a small French village moves to Paris after a misunderstanding with her fiancé, becoming the mistress of a wealthy man.

filmography.title: Nothing Sacred
filmography.role_description: A ruthless newspaper editor who orchestrates the publicity stunt surrounding a woman mistakenly believed to be dying.
filmography.plot: A reporter tries to redeem his reputation by exploiting the story of a Vermont woman who thinks she is dying of radium poisoning, bringing her to New York as a tragic heroine.

filmography.title: Roxie Hart
filmography.role_description: A theatrical and highly successful defense attorney who turns trials into media circuses.
filmography.plot: A dancer confesses to a murder she didn't commit to get publicity for her career, hiring a flashy lawyer to defend her.

filmography.title: The Hucksters
filmography.role_description: The nervous and subservient partner of an advertising agency who cowers before his tyrannical main client.
filmography.plot: A cynical advertising executive finds himself compromised by a powerful, ruthless client while falling in love with a widow.

filmography.title: You Were Never Lovelier
filmography.role_description: A wealthy Argentine hotel owner who tries to orchestrate a romance for his eldest daughter by sending her anonymous orchids.
filmography.plot: A hotel owner tries to find a husband for his cold-hearted eldest daughter by sending her flowers, pretending they are from an unknown admirer.

filmography.title: 100 Men and a Girl
filmography.role_description: An unemployed musician and father whose daughter schemes to get him and his friends a job by forming an orchestra.
filmography.plot: A resourceful young girl tries to persuade a famous conductor to lead an orchestra made up of unemployed musicians, including her father.

filmography.title: Golden Boy
filmography.role_description: A boxing manager who uses his girlfriend to convince a talented violinist to fight for him.
filmography.plot: A young man is torn between his immense talent as a violinist and the financial rewards of becoming a professional boxer.

filmography.title: Topper Returns
filmography.role_description: The father of the wealthy heiress whose friend is murdered in a haunted house.
filmography.plot: A ghost enlists the help of Cosmo Topper to find her murderer and save her wealthy friend.

filmography.title: The Tall Target
filmography.role_description: A seemingly respectable passenger on a train who is revealed to be part of an assassination plot against Abraham Lincoln.
filmography.plot: A police sergeant uncovers a plot to assassinate Abraham Lincoln on a train before his inauguration and tries to stop it.

filmography.title: Step Lively
filmography.role_description: A fast-talking theatrical producer who tries to mount a show while avoiding paying his massive hotel bill.
filmography.plot: A Broadway producer evades bill collectors in a hotel while trying to get his new show off the ground, using a young playwright to stall.

filmography.title: The Sniper
filmography.role_description: A police lieutenant who leads the manhunt for a disturbed serial killer targeting women.
filmography.plot: A disturbed man who hates women embarks on a sniper killing spree in San Francisco, while the police race to profile and catch him.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Writing, Motion Picture Story

filmography.title: The Marriage Circle
filmography.role_description: A cynical man whose flirtatious wife sets her sights on a happily married doctor in this Ernst Lubitsch silent comedy.
filmography.plot: A complex web of flirtation and infidelity threatens the marriage of a happy couple in Vienna.

filmography.title: Morning Glory
filmography.role_description: A theatrical producer who takes an interest in a young, ambitious actress but warns her of the fleeting nature of fame.
filmography.plot: A naive, aspiring actress travels to New York to become a star, encountering romance and the harsh realities of the theater world.

filmography.title: Turnabout
filmography.role_description: A partner in an advertising firm who is befuddled by the sudden personality changes of his associate.
filmography.plot: A husband and wife who are constantly bickering wish they could trade places, and a magical idol grants their wish.

filmography.title: The Milky Way
filmography.role_description: A cynical fight manager who tries to exploit a mild-mannered milkman after a publicized brawl.
filmography.plot: A timid milkman accidentally knocks out the middleweight boxing champion in a street brawl and is subsequently promoted as a prizefighter.
